query: My college is refusing to give back my original certificates even after I completed my course.
Someone has been dumping garbage right outside our house every morning.
My friend’s father passed away, and the bank isn’t allowing his family to access his savings.
A hospital charged us for treatments that were never given to my mother.
My neighbour built a wall that blocks the entrance to our property.
My brother bought a second-hand car and later found out it had fake documents.
A restaurant added extra charges to our bill without telling us beforehand.
My friend’s wedding was cancelled, but the marriage hall refuses to refund the advance.
A teacher slapped my younger brother in school for not completing his homework.
Someone used my Aadhaar details to get a SIM card without my knowledge.
My uncle’s business partner took money from their joint account and disappeared.
A builder promised to hand over our flat last year, but construction is still incomplete.
My friend was forced to work overtime every day without any extra payment.
A private hospital refused to release my father’s medical records.
My neighbour’s dog attacked my younger sister while she was walking home.
Someone has been cutting down trees in our residential area without permission.
My electricity bill suddenly increased to ₹18,000 even though our usage hasn’t changed.
My friend paid a coaching centre for a full course, but they shut down after two weeks.
A security guard at a mall searched my bag and took away my belongings.
My cousin’s husband is refusing to provide money for their child’s basic needs.
A travel agency cancelled our holiday package and isn’t returning the money.
My grandfather gave land to a relative to use temporarily, but now they claim it belongs to them.
My friend was injured at a construction site because the company didn’t provide safety equipment.
Someone recorded me during a private conversation and shared the video without asking.
My apartment association is charging me extra maintenance fees without explaining why.
